parties: Lloyds Enterprises Limited (acquirer) | Steel Infra Solutions Company Limited (target)
headline: Lloyds Enterprises Limited: Acquisition Update on Steel Infra Solutions Company Limited
sum: Lloyds Enterprises Limited disclosed to the NSE an update on its acquisition of equity shares in Steel Infra Solutions Company Limited. The intimation confirms the transaction is in progress and subject to regulatory and contractual conditions.
implication: Listed acquirers must promptly intimate the exchange of material corporate actions; this filing triggers disclosure obligations under SEBI LODR and NSE circulars, requiring continuous updates to the market until closure.
detail: Lloyds Enterprises Limited, a listed entity on the NSE, filed an acquisition update with the stock exchange dated 17 August 2026 regarding its acquisition of equity shares in Steel Infra Solutions Company Limited. The filing confirms the transaction is under way. Specific consideration, completion status, and conditions precedent are not disclosed in the primary intimation; further details would be contained in the full acquisition agreement or subsequent exchange filings.

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (SEBI LODR), Regulation 30
framework.note: Central: Requires listed entities to disclose material corporate actions (acquisitions, mergers) to the exchange within 30 minutes of Board approval or public announcement.
Central: Governs scheme of arrangement / acquisition of shares; may require shareholder approval if acquisition is material or part of a scheme.

framework.ref: NSE Listing Agreement & NSE Circulars on Acquisitions & Material Events
framework.note: Central: Prescribes timelines and content requirements for intimations to the exchange; continuous updates required until closure.
May apply if transaction triggers acquisition thresholds; CCI approval may be a condition precedent.
Relevant only if Steel Infra Solutions has foreign shareholding or if acquirer has overseas components.
Due diligence requirement for large acquisitions; parties must verify KYC/beneficial ownership.
Tax neutrality or deferral implications if acquisition structured as merger/scheme; Section 49A may apply to cost of acquisition.

framework.ref: IEPF Rules / Ministry of Corporate Affairs Notifications
framework.note: If Steel Infra Solutions has unclaimed shareholder funds, escrow provisions may apply.

conditions: Shareholder approval if material under SEBI LODR

triggers.note: Requires prompt disclosure of material corporate action; filed 17 Aug 2026.
If transaction value or combined turnover exceeds thresholds, CCI notification/approval required.
If acquisition involves scheme or merger, may require NCLT/court sanction.

firms.note: No legal counsel named in the NSE intimation; details not disclosed in primary filing.
